capabilities: Add a Gallery layout (mosaic or justified rows) to a Bases view of notes
Browse photos, videos and PDFs in a zoom view with playback and keyboard controls
Show each note's properties and, with Obsidian Maps, a location map beside the media
Embed notes that represent media files as the media itself
Open images inside notes with the zoom instead of the default viewer
disambiguation: Not a media file organizer; it is a gallery view over notes that link to media, not a tool for moving or renaming files.
extras: The plugin uses undocumented Obsidian and Bases internals for media notes, so embeds may revert to ordinary note embeds if Obsidian changes them; it hasn't been tested on phones or tablets; thumbnails are cached locally (up to 300 MB in IndexedDB) and never synced.
intentEvidence: Media Manager adds a Gallery layout to Bases that shows each note's photo, video or PDF
problem: Bases can only list notes as rows or cards of text, so there is no visual way to browse a collection of notes by their photos, videos or PDFs.

relations.evidence: If the note has a location and the Obsidian Maps plugin is installed and enabled, the card ends with a small map
media notes use Bases' and Obsidian's internals, the same way the Custom Views plugin does
Clicking a tile grows it to fill the window, the way MUBI's notebook does

summary: Adds a Gallery layout to Bases that shows each note's photo, video or PDF as tiles, with a zoom view, video playback, PDF reading and property cards.
